    "Practical choices depend on compatibility, scale, quantity, and whether an item complements existing ownership.",
    "Entertainment choices depend on specific sound, story, tone, format, and occasion rather than broad familiarity alone.",
    "Sparse or unidentified histories provide limited support for confident preference extrapolation."

    "The proportion of top-ranked items users would choose now, distinguishing immediate choices from merely plausible matches.",
    "The frequency of rejected top-ranked items attributed to redundant ownership, incompatibility, excessive quantity, or an unsupported project assumption.",
    "The frequency with which users prefer a lower-ranked item because it better matches a recent specific interest than higher-ranked broadly related items.",

}
